title: Density-based longitudinal neuron tracking in high-density electrophysiological recordings
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Assign the same neuron across recording sessions using DANT’s original longitudinal tracking task. Increase valid tracking duration while retaining source matching precision/recall, PETH consistency and false-match controls; total matches or track duration alone is not accuracy.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Assign the same neuron across recording sessions using DANT’s original longitudinal tracking task. Increase valid tracking duration while retaining source matching precision/recall, PETH consistency and false-match controls; total matches or track duration alone is not accuracy.

Source-paper comparison for Figure5D estimated marginal mean tracked length in sessions, conditional on original matching-quality safeguards: Primary Figure5D endpoint is tracked length in sessions estimated by Equation19, not raw pair yield. Mandatory fidelity measures include Figure5E PETH Fisher-z correlation and5H/I precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN) against joint Kilosort2.5 sorting; that reference is close to ground truth, not direct neuron identity.
success_criteria: Authenticate the exact original Figure5 units, sessions, exclusions and common preprocessing; reproduce8.63sessions with the original model and source DANT settings before comparison.

Exceed source DANT tracking duration by a justified meaningful margin while meeting a predeclared non-degradation rule for original matching precision, recall, PETH consistency and false-match controls; never reward over-merging.
Recover and use original Figure5H/I session pairs and joint-sort reference: published DANT precision96.0%±4.8%SD and recall81.5%±11.2%SD are safeguards, not newly chosen held-out identity labels.

Retain source Figure5E rate/day/pair-count filters, unmatched-pair analysis and Figure6 cross-shank false-match validation with their original scopes. Recover numerical reference arrays before deciding non-degradation margins.
Use the same inputs and default-policy boundary for source methods; a new animal split, all13-dataset comparison or probability-calibration task is a separately named extension.
Freeze candidate and all comparison rules before final scoring; improved p-values, engineered fixture success and local all-pair yield cannot count as surpassing the paper.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.improvement_loop: After original cohort and independent validation recovery, develop matching using declared waveform/session information and permitted development feedback, retaining PETH and final joint-sort references outside matching/tuning. Maintain every candidate evaluation in the ledger.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze clustering/motion parameters, matching thresholds, preprocessing, eligible populations, seed policy and resource/access budgets before original final matching and fidelity assessment.
episode.final_evaluation: Run frozen candidate and authentic DANT/UnitMatch/EMD baselines on identical original units/sessions; estimate the original tracked-length EMM and score all original fidelity checks under the predeclared improvement rule.
episode.baseline_policy: Published DANT8.63sessions is the historical anchor; an authenticated DANT rerun is separately reported. UnitMatch and EMD are original controls, not replacements for DANT. Source proxies, joint-sort validation and direct ground truth must remain explicitly distinguished.
